data.lesson: Fixing one wiring bug exposed three more along the same path; end-to-end runs on real data find what unit tests miss.

Two new defects surfaced and were fixed: the reopened source was picked by both scouts (now once per cycle; discover serialized) and the duplicate evaluation re-used the lab's cached failed run and overwrote the status (corrected with history). E3 used 2 LLM calls (per-role cap 1) through a concurrency race (cycle cap of 3 held, $0.24): challenge is now serialized.
